title: Local AI controls and translation reliability
privacy: Only existing local loopback backends. No cloud fallback, downloads, or Live Translate changes.

acceptance: Expose which backend/model will actually run and distinguish managed fixed model from external model
Switch models explicitly and verify requests before and after save/reopen on the OCR popup/dashboard paths
Allow saving optional per-task prompts with default/reset behavior and validate size
evidence: Windows WebView2 verified saved model/prompt applies to an already open quick-tool popup and OCR inline; native request used the selected local model. Unit tests cover prompt expansion and ordering.

acceptance: Reproduce repeated output from a single backend response; remove only provable repeated full translations of single-line input
Preserve intentional repeated lines and formatting on multiline input; test both translation entry points
Keep old settings compatible and reject stale configuration responses
evidence: Windows WebView2 verified one translated result when the default prompt returned the same translation twice. Browser regressions cover intentionally repeated multiline output and custom prompts.

acceptance: Independent Advisor review of the final diff
Run Windows WebView2 and native loopback-provider regressions, including save/reopen and explicit model change
Only mark checks passed after verified evidence; no merge until review and tests pass
evidence: Independent GPT-6.2 Astra approved the same implementation tree and separately reviewed the Windows test-only socket fix. Hosted Windows checks: dashboard API + WebView2, full native regression, actual extracted ZIP smoke, and local English runtime. Optional Vietnamese runtime and physical hardware were not tested.

verification.notes: The full Windows rerun used the identical candidate SHA. Package window detection timed out in attempt 1; actual extracted ZIP UIA smoke and artifact upload passed on attempt 2. This status-only update does not change shipped files.
